item.title: What you need to know about the 7 May elections in England, Scotland and Wales
item.description: Millions will vote in parliamentary elections in Scotland and Wales, and local elections in England.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: Oil prices rise after US and Iran exchange fire in Hormuz strait
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire between Washington and Tehran is still in place.

item.title: Trump's 'irresponsible war' to blame for economic slowdown, German minister says
item.description: Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil blamed the US president's "irresponsible war in Iran" for harming the Germany economy.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi says the US opts for a "reckless military adventure" every time a "diplomatic solution is on the table".

item.title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of breaching Victory Day ceasefire
item.description: The two sides report responding to hundreds of drone attacks, just hours into a truce to cover celebrations of the Soviet Union's victory over Nazi Germany.

item.title: International cyber attack disrupts swathe of universities and schools
item.description: A hacking group breached the academic software Canvas, used by thousands of schools and universities across the globe.

item.title: Three dead after volcano erupts on Indonesian island
item.description: Officials had previously issued warnings on climbing the active volcano due to safety concerns.

item.title: Anti-war protests rock Japan as PM pushes for stronger defence
item.description: Japan's largest anti-war protests in decades highlight a population divided over changes to its pacifist constitution.
